text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 adds SA region but missing HK residency note. Can someone pick up the residency wording and update SDK examples?
Diego Ramos: Taking this. I can update the region matrix + Python/TS snippets. Any legal-approved phrasing for "data residency" we should use?
Priya Nair: Hi — legal prefers: "Customer data stored in regional deployments remains subject to local jurisdiction; on-prem deployments retain customer custody." Short version: keep it factual, avoid 'guarantee' words.
Maya Patel: Perfect, Priya. Please add that as a footnote under 'Data residency' and add link to compliance page. Also we need to change the JS SDK snippet to show region header: 
Sam Chen: Dropping suggested snippet:
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-xxl',
  input: '...',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-region': 'sa' }
})
```
Diego Ramos: For HK, should region key be 'hk' or 'asia-hk'? The current matrix is inconsistent.
Maya Patel: Use 'hk' — we've standardized on 2-letter region codes. I'll patch the matrix if you update snippets.
Priya Nair: Also add this line for on-prem note: "On-prem installations can be configured to restrict storage to customer-controlled volumes." Legal approved.
docs-ci: linter found a broken link in PR 4567: /docs/residency -> should be /docs/compliance/residency. 
Diego Ramos: Thanks — I'll fix the link and push. Anyone want to review once I open the update?
Sam Chen: I can review the snippet + smoke test in staging (will test python + node). ETA end of day.
Maya Patel: Awesome. Diego, mark the PR ready-for-review and @Sam Chen for snippets. Priya — can you add the legal note as a separate commit so it's easier to revert if wording changes? 
Priya Nair: Yep, will do. Adding commit now. 
Diego Ramos: Pushed update at 2167890301, changed link, added hk region code, updated README region matrix. 
docs-ci: Build passed. spellcheck warns: 'residency' ok, 'on-prem' inconsistent (onprem vs on-prem). 
Sam Chen: Fixed on-prem wording in snippets. Ran node test — headers correctly set. 
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Once Sam approves, I'll merge and schedule a tiny site deploy tomorrow. 
legal-bot: Reminder: For Hong Kong jurisdiction mention, ensure translations for CN/EN versions are synced. 
Maya Patel: Noted. I'll open a follow-up task to get translations after merge. 
Sam Chen: Approved. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Merging now. Thanks everyone.
